title: Time Management the Islamic Way
description: Getting the most out of your time: how to be a productive Muslim using the Qur'an and Sunnah. Practical habits, daily routines and time planning from the Salafi methodology, taught by Ustadh Muhammad Tim Humble and Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan (AMAU Academy).
short_description: Be a productive Muslim: time management from the Qur'an

modules.title: The Productive Muslim
modules.description: What productivity means in Islam and how to start.

lessons.content: What productive means in Islam: salah on time, wudu', mujahadah with the soul, and a plan for the day. Ustadh Muhammad Tim Humble, AMAU.

lessons.title: Why You're Wasting Your Life | #2 How to be a Productive Muslim
lessons.content: The real reasons we waste our lives - wasted age, wasted years, and what to do about them today. Ustadh Muhammad Tim Humble, AMAU.

lessons.title: The Most Effective Way To Stay Motivated || Ustadh Abdulrahman Hassan
lessons.content: Motivation the Islamic way - what actually works and what doesn't. AMAU.

lessons.content: A daily routine that works: habits, wudu', sleep, early rising and consistency. AMAU.
